deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a bibliographic memorandum headed 'Neue Bücher von 1821' ('New books of 1821'). It lists newly appeared or newly available volumes, most likely ones Gauss noted to read, borrow (for example from the Göttingen library or a reading society) or acquire. The entries are:

(1) Abhandlungen der (Königlichen) Akademie der Wissenschaften in Berlin for 1818 and 1819, quarto.
(2) F. J. Bertuch, Neue Bibliothek der wichtigsten Reisebeschreibungen, vols. 24–30. The '29' looks squeezed in above the line, i.e. added later.
(3) Goethe, Zur Naturwissenschaft überhaupt, Bd. 1 Heft 3 and Bd. 2.
(4) F. H. von der Hagen, Briefe in die Heimat, vol. 4.
(5) Krünitz, Oekonomisch-technologische Encyklopädie, vols. 128, 129, 130–133.
(6) K. Mannert, Geographie der Griechen und Römer, part 4.
(7) Magazin von merkwürdigen neuen Reisebeschreibungen, vols. 35 and 36.
(8) G. C. B. Busch, Handbuch der Erfindungen, part 11.
(9) O. von Kotzebue, Entdeckungs-Reise in die Süd-See und nach der Berings-Strasse, parts 1–3 (1821).
(10) A. H. Niemeyer, Beobachtungen auf Reisen, parts 1–3.
(11) J. F. Wurm, De ponderum, nummorum, mensurarum ac de anni ordinandi rationibus apud Romanos et Graecos (1821). This is metrology, of evident interest to Gauss.
(12) J. J. Berzelius, Versuch über die Theorie der chemischen Proportionen, Dresden 1820.
(13) C. F. Nebenius, Der öffentliche Credit, 1820.
(14) Transactions of the Royal Society of Edinburgh, vol. 9 part 1.
(15) Philosophical Transactions for 1820, 1821, 1822 and 1823.
(16) Gentleman's Magazine for 1820, 1822 and 1824.
(17) James Mill, History of British India, vols. 1–6 (1820 edition).
(18) T. R. Malthus, Principles of Political Economy, 1820.

The years 1822–1824 in items 15–16 show the list was kept up and extended after 1821.

Context: the previous page is a similar list of travel literature plus measurements of Gauss's hats. The next page continues the book list (Oxley, Gergonne's Annales, Delambre) and then records administrative dates for the Hanoverian survey reports of 1822.

No derivation exists to reconstruct.

results.what: List of recently published books and serials (science, travel, metrology, economics) noted by Gauss c. 1821–1824
results.modern_name: Reading/acquisition list (bibliographic note); evidence for Gauss's reading interests

deep.surprise_reason: Purely bibliographic page with no mathematical content. Gauss's broad reading in travel literature, economics and science is well documented, for example through his library borrowing records.
transcription_corrections: Bertuch volume list: the '29' appears written above the line between 28 and 30, as a later insertion; the transcription renders it inline without noting this.
'Mannerts' is correct (Konrad Mannert), and 'Kotzebue Entdeckungsreise in die Südsee' is correct as read.
'James Mills' is Gauss's spelling of James Mill; this is not a transcription error.
Otherwise the machine transcription matches the image.
